title: Heavy, Edged-in-Gold Rose Is Oddly Weighted
text:
Heavy, Edged-in-Gold Rose Is Oddly Weighted. This ICREER 24K DIPPED GOLD ROSE WITH STAND (Pink) is advertised as a giftable “dipped” rose. What it is, is a home decor piece. A fresh long-stemmed rose is encased in plastic and then edged with gold. But the stem is so straight, it looks and feels like a gold-colored metal rod. The overall impression is that the rose is manufactured.

I don’t care for this “forever” rose at all. Although you can see the veins of the original rose petals through the plastic, the piece is very artificial-looking, and it’s very heavy. Something about the weighting, with the heavy bud atop the rod-like stem, makes me want to swing it and hit something with it. (No kidding. This happens every time that I pick it up.) As a gift, I would far rather receive a single fresh rose than one of these “dipped gold” roses.

The rose comes in a nice, plastic-foam-lined, presentation box. A fancy gift tag is also included.

Before you buy, you should consider where you might want to display this rose. It’s a decorative piece that is an awkward height, and that is easily knocked over. (The plastic stand adds even more height.) Also, you should shop around for the best Amazon price. “Gold-plated” roses with closed buds like this one seem to cost a little more than the ones with open flowers assembled from plastic-coated, gold-edged petals.
